nodes.label: Gray window icon with three dots
nodes.rationale: 16×16 SVG, one even-odd path filled #666. Outer frame runs from (0,1) to (16,15) with 2.5-radius bottom corners. Inner pane from (1.5,2.5), 13 by 10 with 1-radius bottom corners, is left unfilled. Three filled circles of radius 0.75 sit in the pane at (3.75,4.75), (6.25,4.75), and (8.75,4.75). No text, stroke, or background.
